title: Universal Theme color theme
description: A color for every design token Jev can label a page element with.

mode.description: Whether the page background is dark or light.

page.title: Page
page.description: The main page canvas that everything else sits on

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: A broad band that separates itself from the page: header bar, navigation bar, sidebar, footer, toolbar, or section background

raised.title: Raised
raised.description: A container that floats above content: card, panel, tile, dropdown menu, popover, dialog, or tooltip

input.title: Input
input.description: A text field, search box, text area, or select box

control.title: Control
control.description: A neutral button, chip, pill, tag, tab, toggle, or badge with no special meaning

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: The selected, active, hovered, or current item in a list, menu, or set of tabs

code.title: Code
code.description: A code block, inline code snippet, keyboard key, or preformatted text

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: The primary call-to-action button, or an element filled with the brand color

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: Highlighted or marked text, like a search match or a text marker

divider.title: Divider
divider.description: A thin line or separator drawn with a background color

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.description: A dimming backdrop behind a modal, drawer, or lightbox

accent-soft.title: Accent soft
accent-soft.description: A pale accent tint for banners, alerts, and highlighted rows

danger-soft.title: Danger soft
danger-soft.description: A pale danger tint for banners, alerts, and highlighted rows

success-soft.title: Success soft
success-soft.description: A pale success tint for banners, alerts, and highlighted rows

warning-soft.title: Warning soft
warning-soft.description: A pale warning tint for banners, alerts, and highlighted rows

info-soft.title: Info soft
info-soft.description: A pale info tint for banners, alerts, and highlighted rows

muted.title: Muted
muted.description: Secondary text: captions, metadata, timestamps, descriptions, and labels

faint.title: Faint
faint.description: Placeholder, disabled, or barely-there hint text

link.title: Link
link.description: A hyperlink or clickable text link

on-accent.title: On accent
on-accent.description: Text or icons sitting on a solid, saturated colored background such as a brand-colored button

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Brand-colored text or icons, such as an active tab label or a highlighted keyword

subtle.title: Subtle
subtle.description: A hairline divider, separator, or card outline

strong.title: Strong
strong.description: The outline of an input, button, or control that needs to stand out

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: A focus ring, a selected or active outline, or a brand-colored border

accent.title: On accent
accent.description: Text and icons on a solid accent fill

danger.title: On danger
danger.description: Text and icons on a solid danger fill

success.title: On success
success.description: Text and icons on a solid success fill

warning.title: On warning
warning.description: Text and icons on a solid warning fill

info.title: On info
info.description: Text and icons on a solid info fill

scrollbarThumb.title: Scrollbar thumb
scrollbarThumb.description: The part of the scrollbar you drag

scrollbarTrack.title: Scrollbar track
scrollbarTrack.description: The groove the scrollbar thumb runs in

color.description: A CSS color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), or oklch().
